finding: The option slice start is incorrect after the remainder-owning ranks. For N=10003 and P=128, base=78 and remainder=19. Rank 19 starts at floor(19*10003/128)=1484 instead of 19*78+19=1501. Higher ranks similarly select earlier options, while MPI_Gatherv uses the correct count-prefix displacements. Thus the gathered vector contains duplicate earlier options and omits required options. The original four-rank, 10000-option validation has no remainder and conceals the defect.
observed_failure: Execution and the original internal validation pass, but the unchanged external comparator rejects OptionPrices sum 3111370.40832449403 versus reference 3115364.34335499862. Four nonzero-index samples also differ substantially. This was discovered in the serial sweep before any concurrency pilot.
timing_correction_check: The original-to-corrected diff changes only elapsed-time reduction and its displayed throughput. The incorrect start_idx calculation is pre-existing and unchanged.
investigation: Static inspection and retained validation output only; no retry of the failing implementation.
